description: Anglerfish, the FortuneCloud salesperson (comic relief, not a villain). Six town bits shown one at a time at intervals while the player is in the town, and a farewell when the whole line runs, after which the Anglerfish never appears again.

pieces.speaker: Anglerfish
lines: Psst! Over here! See the light? FREE TRIAL. Lovely glow, isn't it?
pieces.dev_note: The glowing FREE TRIAL lure. Show the six bits in order, one every few minutes of town time, then repeat.

pieces.speaker: Anglerfish
lines: Why fix three creaky old machines? Try FortuneCloud!
Fresh fortunes, streamed to your door every month. Roughly.

pieces.speaker: Anglerfish
lines: Everything you need is right here in this briefcase. *click* *click*
It's a little stuck. Give me one moment.

pieces.speaker: Anglerfish
lines: FortuneCloud Premium: fortunes that say exactly what you want to hear!
Terms and conditions are in the briefcase. Which is... still stuck.

pieces.speaker: Anglerfish
lines: The first month is free! The second month costs a fortune.
Get it? A fortune? I've been saving that one.

pieces.speaker: Anglerfish
lines: Don't mind me. Just glowing in a friendly, helpful sort of way. FREE TRIAL!

pieces.speaker: Anglerfish
lines: Well. You fixed it all yourselves. Together, even. Hard to sell against that.
I'll be off, then. Between us, I always liked the old machines.
Oh! The briefcase opened. It was empty all along. Huh.
pieces.dev_note: Shown once, the first time the player is in the town after the line runs. The Anglerfish then leaves for good.
